title: Derived extension along the algebraic-closure topology inclusion
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$. Let $c:C\to B$ be the canonical inclusion of the finite-subextension-valued algebraic-closure coefficient ring into the all norm-continuous coefficient ring [def-sfb-algcl-topology-inclusion]. For any scheme $X$, put $C_X=p_X^*C$, $B_X=p_X^*B$ and $c_X=p_X^*c$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. In the ordinary unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] of internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], define $J_X=B_X\otimes^L_{C_X}-$ to be the actual total left derived scalar-extension functor along $c_X$, computed on K-flat resolutions [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. The abbreviation algClTopologyScalarExtension names this functor. No constructibility, boundedness, properness or flatness assumption is made.
